name: smwmusic-f-zero-silence-arrangement
title: F-Zero - Silence (Arrangement)
description:
An arrangement of "Silence" from F-Zero.

Original soundtrack description:

This is F-Zero on the SNES' entire OST, but redone using higher quality samples.

As to why I did this, after I made Mute City and Port Town, I thought, "What if the whole soundtrack were originally done in this style? What would it sound like"? whilst not making some of the songs completely and entirely different, so I decided to carry on with the idea.

I hope you guys like these ports, because I sure liked making them.

Update 1 (7/29/2019): Replaced all songs that had #tempoimmunity with $F4$07 because #tempoimmunity apparently doesn't work.
